_comment: Copy to crawler/config.json and edit. inworkSource is the ORIGINAL report on the Q: drive; fix the folder part of the path to match where it lives on the share. Sources may be a drive-letter or UNC path, a path relative to the synced OneDrive folder, %ENV% expanded, a OneDrive/SharePoint sharing link, or graph:/path-in-my-OneDrive.

driveMap._comment: UNC path behind each mapped drive letter, used when the letter is not mounted (scheduled tasks often cannot see mapped drives). Example: "Q:": "\\\\EMPIRE-SERVER\\Sales"

graph._comment: Only needed when the crawler runs on a machine without the OneDrive sync client. Register an app in Entra ID (Mobile/desktop, redirect https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/oauth2/nativeclient, Allow public client flows = Yes, delegated permission Files.ReadWrite).

knownItems._comment: Graph ids of the OneDrive copies of the report, if you ever want them as inworkFallbackSource.
